name: Einstein
source:
A robot that's been placed in the corner of Shuuta's room.
He's occasionally made to join Shuuta when he talks to himself.
He sometimes gets taken apart for no other reason but to kill time.

[Translated from the [url=https://glovety.product.co.jp/]official site[/url]]
